cohort: 145 fetuses with HLHS, diagnosed and monitored between 2008 and 2015
finding: Prenatally diagnosed foramen ovale restriction may be a predictor of longer hospitalization, but not of a need for an urgent Rashkind procedure in fetuses with HLHS.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the severe urgent HLHS group compared to the severe planned HLHS group (79.2% vs 62%, p = 0.15).
